observations: Original 'Fat' model Sony PlayStation 4 console in black.
The console casing shows visible scuffs and dust on the top surface.
Image contains a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJIMISHAEL JEREMIAH'.
The console is the early version with a split matte/glossy top plate.

claims.evidence: photo 0 shows the original thick chassis design with the light bar strip.
External scuffs are visible, and internal functionality or port health cannot be determined from a photo.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have a 'Blue Light of Death' (BLOD) failure.
risks.proof: Video of the console booting from a cold start to the main dashboard.

risks.risk: The optical disc drive may be unable to read or eject discs.
risks.proof: Video of a game disc being inserted, recognized, and launched.
risks.if_unproven: as having a faulty disc drive

risks.risk: Controllers may suffer from stick drift or unresponsive buttons.
risks.proof: Video of both controllers being used to navigate menus or in a controller tester.
Photo of the 'System Storage' settings screen.

proof_requests: Video of the console booting up to the home screen.
Video demonstrating a game disc being read and played.
Photo of the system information screen showing storage capacity.
Close-up photo of the HDMI port to check for pin damage.
response.reason: The item is identified as a PS4 Fat with two controllers. Due to the lack of proof of functionality, it is priced at its worst-case value as a non-working unit for parts.
